note: Every third-party input of Warzag's engine (native arm64 Wine + ARM64EC, FEX, DXMT, lsteamclient), pinned like neutron's build.sh. runtime/n/fetch.sh downloads and verifies them into $WARZAG_CACHE/work/n/{downloads,repos}. Versions and commits are neutron's; sha256 values were computed on first download (TOFU) unless a GitHub release digest or a git commit id anchors them.

neutron.use: Engine build recipe (build.sh pins) and the patch series vendored in runtime/n/patches (see its README.md). Its Steam integration (Steam.app change, steam_dev.cfg, CEF hook, Node, compatibilitytools.d) is not used by Warzag.

wine.pinned_by: TOFU from dl.winehq.org over HTTPS; the detached signature names the WineHQ release key above (verified by fetch.sh --verify-signatures when gpg is installed)
wine.use: Wine: aarch64 unix side, ARM64EC + aarch64 (ARM64X) PE side

llvm-mingw.license: Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception (toolchain); mingw-w64 runtime ZPL-2.1 and public domain
llvm-mingw.use: PE cross compilers: aarch64-, arm64ec- and x86_64-w64-mingw32 (Wine's PE side, FEX, DXMT, steam.exe); winnt.h patched and CRT startup objects rebuilt (patches/llvm-mingw)

sdl2-compat.use: The SDL2 API winebus dlopens (libSDL2-2.0.0.dylib), on top of SDL3

wine-mono.license: MIT and the licenses of its parts
wine-mono.use: Pinned like neutron but not bundled by default (Warframe and DE's launcher need no .NET). runtime/n/build.sh --with-mono unpacks it into share/wine/mono.

shared.note: Sources of the bundled TLS/font libraries, pinned in runtime/inputs.lock.json and built for arm64 here (neutron bundles Homebrew bottles instead, which target the newest macOS and pull in more libraries).

proton.license: lsteamclient: Steamworks SDK license (fetched at build time, never committed); steam_helper: BSD-3-Clause
proton.note: lsteamclient/ and steam_helper/ are identical to tag proton-11.0-2e (bc896217).
proton.use: lsteamclient built inside the Wine tree (dlls/lsteamclient) for ARM64EC/aarch64 PE + aarch64 unixlib

fex.use: x86-64 emulator: libarm64ecfex.dll (ARM64EC, the xtajit64 role) + libarm64ecfex.so (macOS unixlib)

dxmt.use: D3D10/11/12 -> Metal: ARM64EC PE DLLs + aarch64 winemetal.so

llvm-project.use: LLVM 15 libraries (no targets) for DXMT's airconv shader converter, linked into winemetal.so

mingw-w64.use: The CRT sources llvm-mingw 20260908 was built from; its startup objects are rebuilt with the TSD NtCurrentTeb
